item.title: February Jobs Report: U.S. Sheds 92K Positions; Unemployment Hits 4.4%
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS — The U.S. lost 92,000 jobs in February and the unemployment rate rose to 4.4%. That’s a sharp contrast to the estimated 50,000 loss. University of Indianapolis economist Dr. Matt Will suggests these numbers are the byproduct of “creative destruction,” a theory where old economic models wither away to make room for the new. […]

item.title: Former Colts Center Ryan Kelly Announces Retirement
item.description: INDIANAPOLIS — Former Indianapolis Colts center Ryan Kelly announced his retirement from the NFL. The Colts selected Kelly with the 18th pick in the 2016 NFL Draft. He spent nine seasons in Indianapolis, where he started 121 games and made four Pro Bowls. The final season of Kelly’s NFL career was with the Minnesota Vikings […]
